title: Playboy February 1988 Page 3 Girls Oliver Stone Interview Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, February 1988 issue, original $3.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Britain's Page 3 Girls; From Platoon to Wall Street - an interview with Oliver Stone; A Thrill Seeker's Winter Guide; Why We Must Spy, by William F. Buckley, Jr.; Ben Stein on greed in Hollywood.

Back cover: Salem cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
